regression_distinction: Prior full specifications intentionally retain distinct selection/OOS costs for exact B3B regression; the new standard UI has a separately tested equal-cost matrix. Different financial specifications are never represented as an unchanged-results comparison.

matrix.name: rolling_monthly

dynamic_costs.gross_and_net_distinction: Net equals gross because the explicitly stored transaction cost is zero.

matched_beta_diagnostic.label: Retrospective matched-beta diagnostic
matched_beta_diagnostic.explanation: This control is constructed after observing the completed OOS path. It is a diagnostic benchmark, not an ex-ante investable strategy.

DYNAMIC_EXPOSURE.performance_methodology: Certified capital summarize: 252 / OOS observations annualization and sample-variance net Sharpe; independent-sleeve returns compounded.

capm_alpha_diagnostic.annualization: Daily intercept and its standard error multiplied by 252; t-statistic unchanged.

capital_efficiency.explanation: Lower average exposure may release capital for other independent strategies. This does not by itself establish market-timing skill.
